# Sections

This reference describes the packs installed in this build of mineworld; a build with other packs generates a different one (`docs/DECISIONS.md` `ARC-90`). It is generated from the types that read each file, so it is never edited by hand.

Each section a System Pack of this build owns: the key it is written under in a content file, which files may carry it, and every field it may set.

<a id="section-name"></a>

## `name`

Written under the key `name` in `people/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `naming` system (package `mineworld-naming`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

A person's name, as people say it, such as Alice Moreau: 1 to 64 bytes in any script, with no control character and no space at either end.

**Type:** text.

Example:

```yaml
name: Ana Lee
```

<a id="section-persona"></a>

## `persona`

Written under the key `persona` in `people/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `persona` system (package `mineworld-persona`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

How the person is and how they speak: a summary, at most 8 traits, and an optional note on speech. It shapes the person's words and grants them nothing.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `speech` | [Speech](#section-persona-speech) | no | — | — | A note on how the person speaks: at most 160 bytes. Absent, none. |
| `summary` | [Summary](#section-persona-summary) | yes | — | — | Who the person is, in a sentence or two: 1 to 280 bytes. Required. |
| `traits` | [Traits](#section-persona-traits) | no | — | — | Short words for the person's character, in the order written: at most 8, each at most 32 bytes. Absent, none. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
persona:
  speech: "Short sentences, a dry joke now and then."
  summary: "Runs the corner shop. Patient with children, brisk with salesmen."
  traits:
    - patient
    - brisk
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-persona-speech"></a>

#### `Speech`

A note on how the person speaks: at most 160 bytes.

**Type:** text.

<a id="section-persona-summary"></a>

#### `Summary`

Who the person is, in a sentence or two: 1 to 280 bytes.

**Type:** text.

<a id="section-persona-trait"></a>

#### `Trait`

One short word for the person's character: at most 32 bytes.

**Type:** text.

<a id="section-persona-traits"></a>

#### `Traits`

Short words for the person's character, in the order written: at most 8.

**Type:** list of [Trait](#section-persona-trait).

<a id="section-routine"></a>

## `routine`

Written under the key `routine` in `people/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `schedule` system (package `mineworld-schedule`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

A person's day, in parts: each from a time, at a place, for something. Times strictly increase; two neighbouring parts (the last and the first included, since the day wraps) differ in place or label; the time before the first part belongs to the last.

**Type:** list of [AuthoredSegment](#section-routine-authoredsegment). **Bounds:** 2 to 24 entries.

Example:

```yaml
routine:
  - from: "08:00"
    label: work
    place: shop
    punctual: true
  - from: "18:00"
    label: home
    place: home
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-routine-agendalabel"></a>

#### `AgendaLabel`

What a part of the day is for, in the world's own words, such as work, coffee or home: 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** matches `^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$`.

<a id="section-routine-authoredsegment"></a>

#### `AuthoredSegment`

One part of a person's day: from when, where, and what for.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | [TimeOfDay](#section-routine-timeofday) | yes | — | — | When this part of the day begins, every day. |
| `label` | [AgendaLabel](#section-routine-agendalabel) | yes | — | — | What it is for, in the world's own words: the label others see. |
| `place` | [EntityKey](#section-routine-entitykey) | yes | — | — | Where the person spends it: a place key. |
| `punctual` | true or false | no | `false` | — | The person means to be at the place when this part begins, so whoever drives them sets out early enough to arrive by `from`. Without it, `from` is when they set out. Marking a part that follows a shift punctual makes the person leave that shift early. |

<a id="section-routine-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="section-routine-timeofday"></a>

#### `TimeOfDay`

A time of day on a 24-hour clock, HH:MM, such as "06:30" — quoted in YAML.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** matches `^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$`.

<a id="section-item"></a>

## `item`

Written under the key `item` in `items/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `item` system (package `mineworld-item`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

What sort of thing this item kind is, and what it is called: `item: { category: drink, name: Flat White }`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | [Category](#section-item-category) | yes | — | — | The sort of thing it is, such as drink, food or goods: packs and clients may group kinds by it. |
| `name` | [ItemName](#section-item-itemname) | yes | — | — | What the kind is called where people read it, as clients show it in a catalogue. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
item:
  category: food
  name: Croissant
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-item-category"></a>

#### `Category`

The sort of thing an item kind is, such as drink, food or goods: 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -, not beginning or ending with -.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="section-item-itemname"></a>

#### `ItemName`

A kind's display name, as a person reads it, such as Flat White: 1 to 64 bytes in any script, with no control character and no space at either end.

**Type:** text.

<a id="section-holdings"></a>

## `holdings`

Written under the key `holdings` in `people/<key>.yaml`, `organizations/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `inventory` system (package `mineworld-inventory`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

What this person or organization holds when the world begins: an item key, then how many (at least 1). A person holds at most 6 items in all.

**Type:** mapping: each key matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`, each value is whole number (at least 1).

Example:

```yaml
holdings:
  bread: 2
  tea: 1
```

<a id="section-economy"></a>

## `economy`

Written under the key `economy` in `people/<key>.yaml`, `organizations/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `economy` system (package `mineworld-economy`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

Money: what this person or organization has when the world begins, and, for an organization, the shop it runs.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shop` | [AuthoredShop](#section-economy-authoredshop) | no | — | — | The shop this holder runs. Only an organization runs one; on a person's file it is refused. |
| `wallet` | whole number | yes | — | at least 0 | The money held when the world begins, in minor units (cents: 2000 is 20.00). |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
economy:
  shop:
    at: shop
    prices:
      bread: 250
  wallet: 2000
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-economy-authoredshop"></a>

#### `AuthoredShop`

A shop, as its operator authors it: where it is and what it sells, at what price.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `at` | [EntityKey](#section-economy-entitykey) | yes | — | — | The place the shop is in: a place key. |
| `prices` | mapping: each key matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`, each value is whole number (at least 1) | yes | — | — | What it sells: an item key, then its price in minor units, at least 1. |

<a id="section-economy-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="section-job"></a>

## `job`

Written under the key `job` in `people/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `employment` system (package `mineworld-employment`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

This person's job: who employs them, where, which hours each day, the wage, and what a shift produces for the employer.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `employer` | [EntityKey](#section-job-entitykey) | yes | — | — | Who employs them: an organization key. |
| `from` | [TimeOfDay](#section-job-timeofday) | yes | — | — | When the shift begins, every day. |
| `produces` | mapping: each key matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`, each value is whole number (at least 1) | no | `{}` | — | What one full shift produces for the employer: an item key, then how many (at least 1). |
| `until` | [TimeOfDay](#section-job-timeofday) | yes | — | — | When the shift ends, the same day: after `from`. |
| `wage` | whole number | yes | — | at least 0 | The wage, in minor units per hour worked, paid by the employer. |
| `workplace` | [EntityKey](#section-job-entitykey) | yes | — | — | Where they work: a place key. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
job:
  employer: corner-shop-co
  from: "08:00"
  produces:
    bread: 4
  until: "16:00"
  wage: 1200
  workplace: shop
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-job-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="section-job-timeofday"></a>

#### `TimeOfDay`

A time of day on a 24-hour clock, HH:MM, such as "06:30" — quoted in YAML.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** matches `^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$`.

<a id="section-body"></a>

## `body`

Written under the key `body` in `places/<key>.yaml`, `items/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `bodies` system (package `mineworld-bodies`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

A body: in a place file, the walkable floor and the solids standing on it (floor, solids); in an item file, one loose object (shape, at). Never both forms.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `at` | [Lies](#section-body-lies) | no | — | — | Where an object lies: a place and a point on its floor. Required, with `shape`, in an item's body. |
| `floor` | [Floor](#section-body-floor) | no | — | — | A place's walkable floor: an axis-aligned rectangle whose edge is the place's walls. Required in a place's body. |
| `shape` | [BodyShape](#section-body-bodyshape) | no | — | — | An object's shape. Required, with `at`, in an item's body. |
| `solids` | list of [Solid](#section-body-solid) | no | — | — | The solid boxes standing on a place's floor — counters, tables, pillars: at most 64. Nobody stands inside one or walks through it. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
body:
  floor:
    max:
      x: 4000
      "y": 3000
    min:
      x: 0
      "y": 0
  solids:
    - height: 900
      max:
        x: 2000
        "y": 3000
      min:
        x: 0
        "y": 2400
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-body-bodyshape"></a>

#### `BodyShape`

A loose object's shape: { box: { x, y, z } } with half-extents of 50 to 400 mm in x and y and 50 to 500 mm in z, or { ball: <radius> } with a radius of 50 to 400 mm.

**Type:** `box:` [HalfExtents](#section-body-halfextents) or `ball:` [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres).

- `box:` [HalfExtents](#section-body-halfextents): A box, axis-aligned with the place: its half-extents.
- `ball:` [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres): A ball: its radius in millimetres.

<a id="section-body-corner"></a>

#### `Corner`

A corner on a place's floor, in the place's frame: `x` east and `y` north of its origin (`CORE_CONCEPTS.md` §6.1).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Millimetres east of the place's origin, within ±100000. |
| `y` | [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Millimetres north of the place's origin, within ±100000. |

<a id="section-body-entitykey"></a>

#### `EntityKey`

An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 64 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?$`.

<a id="section-body-floor"></a>

#### `Floor`

The walkable floor: an axis-aligned rectangle from its south-west corner `min` to its north-east corner `max`. Its edge is the place's walls.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | [Corner](#section-body-corner) | yes | — | — | The north-east corner; each side at least 620 mm from `min`, room for one person to turn. |
| `min` | [Corner](#section-body-corner) | yes | — | — | The south-west corner. |

<a id="section-body-halfextents"></a>

#### `HalfExtents`

A box's half-extents, in millimetres.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Half the box's width (east–west), in millimetres: 50 to 400. |
| `y` | [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Half the box's depth (south–north), in millimetres: 50 to 400. |
| `z` | [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Half the box's height, in millimetres: 50 to 500. |

<a id="section-body-lies"></a>

#### `Lies`

Where an object lies, as authored: a place by key, and a point on its floor.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `place` | [EntityKey](#section-body-entitykey) | yes | — | — | The place it lies in: a place key. |
| `x` | [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Millimetres east of the place's origin. |
| `y` | [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Millimetres north of the place's origin. |

<a id="section-body-millimetres"></a>

#### `Millimetres`

A length or a coordinate, in whole millimetres (1 m = 1000).

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** -2147483648 to 2147483647.

<a id="section-body-solid"></a>

#### `Solid`

A solid box standing on the floor — a counter, a table, a pillar: its footprint from `min` to `max`, and its height above the floor. Nobody stands inside one or walks through it.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `height` | [Millimetres](#section-body-millimetres) | yes | — | — | How high it stands above the floor, in millimetres: 1 to 10000. |
| `max` | [Corner](#section-body-corner) | yes | — | — | The footprint's north-east corner; the footprint is not empty. |
| `min` | [Corner](#section-body-corner) | yes | — | — | The footprint's south-west corner. |

<a id="section-fishing"></a>

## `fishing`

Written under the key `fishing` in `places/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `fishing` system (package `acme-fishing`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

A fishing spot: what a person standing here catches, and how long a catch takes.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `catch` | text | yes | — | — | What is caught here: an item key. |
| `minutes` | whole number | yes | — | 30 to 240 | How long one catch takes, in minutes: 30 to 240. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
fishing:
  catch: fish
  minutes: 60
```

<a id="section-appearance"></a>

## `appearance`

Written under the key `appearance` in `people/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `appearance` system (package `mineworld-appearance`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

How the person looks, named by a key that a client's Presentation Pack draws.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `look` | [LookKey](#section-appearance-lookkey) | yes | — | — | The name of the person's look: 1 to 48 bytes of `a`–`z`, `0`–`9` and `-`. Required. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
appearance:
  look: alice-moreau
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-appearance-lookkey"></a>

#### `LookKey`

The name of a look: 1 to 48 bytes of `a`–`z`, `0`–`9` and `-`, such as `alice-moreau`. It names the look and says nothing of what it is made of; each client's Presentation Pack draws it.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 48 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9-]+$`.

<a id="section-attributes"></a>

## `attributes`

Written under the key `attributes` in `people/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `attributes` system (package `mineworld-attributes`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

The section's shape, for the generated reference (`ARC-90`): a map of attribute ids to an entry. The rules a value must meet are its declaration's, so the schema states the forms, not the domains.

**Type:** mapping: each key is text, each value is [EntrySchema](#section-attributes-entryschema).

Example:

```yaml
attributes:
  attributes-town.chronotype: early-bird
  glasses: true
  hair-colour:
    allowed:
      - brown
      - auburn
  languages:
    - english
    - spanish
  stature: 1.66
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-attributes-entryschema"></a>

#### `EntrySchema`

One entry of the section: a value written in its kind's own form, or a restriction.

**Type:** text or number or true or false or list of text or [RestrictionSchema](#section-attributes-restrictionschema).

<a id="section-attributes-restrictionschema"></a>

#### `RestrictionSchema`

`{ allowed: [...] }` or `{ between: [min, max] }`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed` | list of text | no | `null` | — | For a `category`, `level` or `set`: the values the sampler may draw. |
| `between` | list of number | no | `null` | — | For a `quantity`: the inclusive bounds the sampler may draw within. |

<a id="section-sit-points"></a>

## `sit-points`

Written under the key `sit-points` in `places/<key>.yaml`.
Read by the `posture` system (package `mineworld-posture`), which a world enables in `systems:`. A file whose world does not enable it is refused.

The sit points of one place: at most [`SIT_POINTS_MAX`], keys unique, every pair at least [`SIT_POINT_SPACING`] apart, held sorted by key (`ARC-147`, I-a-2).

**Type:** list of [SitPoint](#section-sit-points-sitpoint).

Example:

```yaml
sit-points:
  - at:
      x: 2700
      "y": 1160
    facing: 180000
    group: window-bench
    key: window-bench.1
  - at:
      x: 3300
      "y": 1160
    facing: 180000
    group: window-bench
    key: window-bench.2
```

### Types used above

<a id="section-sit-points-millimetres"></a>

#### `Millimetres`

A length or a coordinate, in whole millimetres (1 m = 1000).

**Type:** whole number. **Bounds:** -2147483648 to 2147483647.

<a id="section-sit-points-sitgroupkey"></a>

#### `SitGroupKey`

The furniture a sit point belongs to, so that a depiction and a word can name it once: the `window-bench` of `window-bench.1` and `window-bench.2`.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 48 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9.-]+$`.

<a id="section-sit-points-sitpoint"></a>

#### `SitPoint`

One place where one person may sit, on free floor.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `at` | [Spot](#section-sit-points-spot) | yes | — | — | The seated person's position on the place's floor, in millimetres. |
| `facing` | whole number | yes | — | — | The yaw a seated person faces, in millidegrees: `0` faces north, `90 000` east, `180 000` south. |
| `group` | [SitGroupKey](#section-sit-points-sitgroupkey) | no | — | — | The furniture this point belongs to, if any: a slug such as `window-bench`. |
| `key` | [SitPointKey](#section-sit-points-sitpointkey) | yes | — | — | The point's name, unique within its place: 1 to 48 bytes of `a`–`z`, `0`–`9`, `-` and `.`. |

<a id="section-sit-points-sitpointkey"></a>

#### `SitPointKey`

The name of a sit point, unique within its place: `window-bench.1`, `pier-bench.2`.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** 1 to 48 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9.-]+$`.

<a id="section-sit-points-spot"></a>

#### `Spot`

The position of a sit point, as a file writes it: `{ x: 2700, y: 1160 }`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [Millimetres](#section-sit-points-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Millimetres east of the place's origin. |
| `y` | [Millimetres](#section-sit-points-millimetres) | yes | — | — | Millimetres north of the place's origin. |
